findings.issue: "integration": null and "shopifySteps": [] but description states "deactivate their Shopify discounts so customers are not shown a broken widget." The coding agent will implement this capability as a pure database write with no Shopify API call, leaving the automatic discount(s) on a paused bundle active in Shopify. The broken bundle's discount will continue firing at checkout even after the bundle is paused.
findings.fix: Set integration to "shopify-admin" and add a shopifySteps entry that calls discountAutomaticDeactivate (consuming the shopify_discount_external_id from the affected bundles), mirroring the deactivation step already resolved in toggle-bundle-discount-active-state.

findings.issue: "Create one automatic discount node per tier rule" means a bundle with tiers at 2, 3, and 4 items creates three simultaneous active automatic discounts scoped to the same component products. For a cart with 4 bundle items all three discounts are live concurrently and Shopify will attempt to apply each one independently — the customer gets a 10%, 20%, AND 30% discount stacked, not just the highest applicable tier. Shopify's combinesWith setting prevents stacking with other discount types but not with other automatic discounts of the same type.
findings.fix: Replace the one-node-per-tier strategy with a single discountAutomaticBasicCreate that uses Shopify's quantity-break (stepped) pricing or, if the API does not support it natively, store tier logic app-side and apply only the highest matching tier's discount at the point of discount creation/update, deactivating the replaced tier node before creating the new one.

findings.issue: Both columns carry role "money" but their purpose fields explicitly include percentage values (e.g. "10% off", "percentage or flat amount applying at this tier"). The spec defines money as "for currency amounts only" and ratio as "fractional values bounded between 0 and 1." A percentage stored as 10, 20, 30 fits neither money nor ratio, so the coding agent receives an ambiguous signal about the column's domain type and storage range.
findings.fix: Split into two typed columns — one with role money (flat-amount discount) and one with role ratio (percentage discount stored as a decimal 0–1), with each nullable when the discount_kind does not use it; or keep a single value column but change its role to text and document the encoding convention, letting the coding agent choose the correct DDL.

findings.issue: "returnsList": true is set on a write capability whose sole job is to create Shopify discount nodes. The spec defines returnsList as "the capability shows the merchant or customer multiple records they can browse, sort, filter, or paginate." This is a write (create) operation, not a read/browse operation. The flag will mislead the coding agent into generating list-pagination scaffolding for what should be a plain fire-and-persist write path.
findings.fix: Set returnsList to false on create-tier-discounts.
